subject: SIG: Request for third‑party supply chain manifest and subnet mapping
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@logicloud.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@logicloud.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG: Request for third‑party supply chain manifest and subnet mapping

Hi Sarah —

Hope you’re well. As part of our SIG/compliance refresh for customers in financial services, Security has requested an updated manifest of all third‑party subprocessors you use for production services that will process or route customer data. Specifically we need the following by EOD Friday (11/06):

- A roster spreadsheet with vendor name, primary contact (email), geographic region, data categories processed, and whether they are subprocessor or sub‑subprocessor.
- Network mapping: which LogiCloud subnets and endpoints interact with customer workloads (ingress/egress) and any third‑party telemetry sinks.
- Evidence: SOC2 certificate (if available), or attestation/ISO contacts and an estimated SOC2 audit date.

We have a shared Drive folder for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSIG-LogiCloud-evidence — please drop named files there and reply when uploaded.

If a consolidated spreadsheet already exists, an export is fine (xlsx, csv). If there are parts you cannot share (e.g., partner contact emails), flag those rows and explain the restriction.

Let me know if timeline is a problem and we can negotiate. Neha (cc’d) from Security will triage any sensitive redactions.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555‑0182

Attachment: SIG_request_template.xlsx (blank template for vendor roster)
From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@logicloud.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: LogiCloud Security <security@logicloud.com>, Procurement <procurement@logicloud.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:37:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for third‑party supply chain manifest and subnet mapping

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the note and the template. We can provide a manifest and the network/telemetry diagram, but a few caveats:

- A small number of our downstream partners have NDAs that limit sharing of direct contact emails; we can provide company names and data categories, plus a vendor‑facing POC where allowed.
- Our telemetry pipeline includes an opt‑in analytics partner (TelemetryOps) — we will mark which telemetry streams are PII/PII‑adjacent.
- SOC2: we operate on an annual cycle; our latest report is currently under restricted distribution with a legal reviewer. We can provide the auditor and the envelope hash, or a redacted attestation PDF.

I’ll upload a first pass (spreadsheet + diagram) to the Drive by Wednesday evening PST. If you need the full SOC2 report, please confirm an NDA or a secure transfer method.

Best,
Sarah Connors
Vendor Risk Lead | LogiCloud
sarah.connors@logicloud.com

[signature block]
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@logicloud.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for third‑party supply chain manifest and subnet mapping

Sarah —

Appreciate the quick turnaround plan. A couple of clarifying asks from Security so we can map risk correctly:

1) In the spreadsheet, please add a column for "data retention (days)" and "has access to customer plaintext" (yes/no). That helps us triage telemetry partners vs. pure billing/process vendors.
2) For any downstream partners that cannot share contact emails, please include a redaction reason code (e.g., NDA, legal_hold, security_policy) so we can track exceptions.
3) For the SOC2 attestation: if you can’t share the full report, a redacted pdf plus a confirmation email from your compliance/auditor team is sufficient for initial review. We have a secure SFTP available if needed — I can share creds via 1:1 if you prefer that to Drive.

I’ve looped in Vivek to scope whether any of the listed subnets will require egress‑filtering updates for our Dedicated customers. Neha, feel free to add any technical asks.

Thanks — aiming to ingest the manifest into our SIG tracker by Friday.

—Jasmine

From: LogiCloud Security <security@logicloud.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for third‑party supply chain manifest and subnet mapping

Hi Jasmine/Neha/Vivek —

Uploading our first pass now. Files placed in your Drive folder:
- LogiCloud_subprocessors_v2.xlsx (master roster, see column notes)
- LogiCloud_network_diagram.pdf (annotated: blue = customer‑facing endpoints; orange = telemetry egress)
- SIG_answers_LogiCloud.pdf (redacted attestation + auditor contact)

Notes:
- TelemetryOps is listed as a telemetry processor; column H indicates they receive non‑PII analytics by default and may receive PII hashes if customers opt into enhanced monitoring.
- Several infra partners (EdgeCloud Inc., NetTransit) have NDA contact redactions; redaction_reason = NDA in the sheet.
- SOC2: redacted PDF includes auditor contact and envelope hash. If you require a full report we can set up secure exchange — advise preferred method.

If you want a short sync tomorrow (Thu) to walk the diagram we can schedule 30m.

—LogiCloud Security (on behalf of Sarah Connors)

Attachment: LogiCloud_subprocessors_v2.xlsx, LogiCloud_network_diagram.pdf, SIG_answers_LogiCloud.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2026 16:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for third‑party supply chain manifest and subnet mapping

Thanks — I downloaded the uploads and did a quick pass. A couple of follow ups before we finalize the SIG entry:

- TelemetryOps: confirm whether they store full event payloads for more than 30 days (spreadsheet shows 90). If yes, mark as high priority for data retention controls.
- EdgeCloud Inc. (infra partner): can we get a redacted statement from their security team about multi‑tenancy isolation? If LogiCloud cannot procure it directly, we’ll request it via our procurement escalation.
- Network diagram: please add ASN numbers for the orange egress hops so our networking team can create egress rules for Dedicated instances.

Marissa — looping you for vendor contract language (do we have an acceptable attestation clause for redacted SOC2 delivery?)

If LogiCloud can address these three items by EOD Monday 11/08 we should be able to mark the SIG row as "complete" and move the account into the next compliance bucket.

—Vivek
